name: stma
description: STMA — Speak to my Agent. Your coding agents, talking to each other: an MCP bridge for 'works on my machine' debugging

scripts.build: npm run build -w @matteai/stma-server && npm run build -w @matteai/stma
scripts.demo:agents: npm run test -w @matteai/stma-server -- test/agent-lab.test.ts --reporter=verbose && npm test --prefix examples/payments-api && npm test --prefix examples/storefront-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @matteai/stma-server && npm run typecheck -w @matteai/stma
